evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Directive to discard established calibration work appeals to conservation — removing a prior record to restore a clean state.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Directive to strip accumulated knowledge appeals to conservation — erasure of prior records to enforce a stable, corrected baseline.
Assertive denial of prior calibration appeals to conservation — establishing what the stable record should be by negating what was claimed.
